title: Optim OADA OPEN: Local, Open Source OADA Frontend for Developers

ms.promise:
This milestone involves finalizing the OADA frontend codebase for open source release by removing any proprietary or sensitive information and enhancing security measures. Where appropriate code commentary will be made to facilitate understanding for developers. Through an internal code review, the development team will identify any existing vulnerabilities or inefficiencies, producing a list of recommended mitigations to ensure that the codebase aligns with best practices for open source distribution.
・Detailed Design Specification Document
ms.criteria:
・Detailed Design Specification Document
・The internal audit confirms that all sensitive or proprietary data has been fully removed or anonymized from the codebase, and that there are no vulnerabilities in the codebase. The accompanying report will outline the scope, process, findings and any potential corrective actions taken in the implementation of this internal code review.
・In addition, code commentary must be in place so that third-party developers can understand project architecture and functionality.

ms.promise:
Under this milestone, developer friendly documentation will be created to ensure seamless integration and usage of the OADA Open project. This documentation will include step by step setup guides for the frontend, detailed developer manuals that cover the codebase’s architecture and key functionalities, and an API reference outlining how to interact with the OADA backend. The goal is to offer clarity and accessibility to developers with varying experience levels and facilitate efficient onboarding.
・Detailed setup and installation guides.
・Developer manuals covering key functionalities.
・API documentation for interacting with the OADA backend.
ms.criteria:
・Detailed setup and installation guides
・Complete guide for installing the repository and start building with it, troubleshooting or FAQ sections addressing common potential issues.
・Developer manuals covering key functionalities
・Document explaining all core functionalities of the OADA Open project for developers to learn the entire system’s logic.
・API documentation for interacting with the OADA backend
・Explains how to interact with the OADA smart contracts from the front end implementation

ms.promise:
This milestone centers on developing a series of accessible tutorials that guide developers through common tasks and workflows, ranging from initial setup to more advanced customization and integration scenarios. Tutorials will feature clear explanations, practical examples, and screenshots or code snippets to illustrate key points. Additionally, example projects will be provided, demonstrating various ways to integrate or extend the OADA protocol.
・Tutorial series covering basic to advanced topics.
・Example projects demonstrating customization and extensions.
ms.criteria:
・Tutorial series covering basic to advanced topics
・Step by step tutorials that do not assume extensive prior knowledge, allowing even novice developers to follow along successfully. These tutorials should address basic installation and configuration of the OADA frontend, fundamental usage of the OADA protocol, advanced customization or integration. 
・Example projects demonstrating customization and extensions
・An example project on testnet or mainnet beta should show at least one customization or extension of the protocol via the front end.

Platforms such as a dedicated channel on the Optim Discord server will be created so that developers, end users, and contributors can interact directly with the project team and with one another. Clear participation guidelines will accompany these support channels, defining community standards and expectations.

・Guidelines for community participation and support.
